name: DJ Scott's Social Dance Nights
description: Social dance nights with a ballroom-to-rock music mix by DJ Scott at the Knights of Columbus hall in Patchogue.
reviewNotes:
The Dance Calendar lists different phone numbers (631.277.7774 / 631.513.1055); only DJ Scott's own-site number is recorded.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Phone and email are the booking contacts DJ Scott publishes on his own site. Town = where his social dances are held (Knights of Columbus, Patchogue); no own studio, so no street address. The site's 2026 calendar runs only to Oct 16, 2026 ('check back for updates'). No Facebook/Instagram/YouTube found for this DJ (a 'Scott' at Long Island Sound DJ and DanceJock are different DJs). Photos: the dance-floor and empty-hall pictures are from his events page and appear to be the Patchogue K of C hall, but the site does not caption them. Stock (Unsplash) images and celebrity selfies on the site were skipped.

evidence.note: DJ Scott's own site (Purple Penguin Entertainment; djscottmusic.com redirects here) lists 631-357-2881 and scott@djscottmusic.com.
Events page: 'DJ Scott's Summer/Early Fall 2026 Social Dance/Ballroom Mix Calendar' with $20 social dances, 7-11 PM, at the Knights of Columbus, 38 West 1st Street, Patchogue, through Oct 16, 2026.
About page: DJ playing ballroom and social dance music for Long Islanders for over 19 years, plus doo-wop, disco, country, rock and salsa.
